name: marselnenaj/tomacco
title: Tomacco 1.5.0 lets coding agents build, run and test apps with 3.2x faster OCR
summary: Tomacco 1.5.0 aims to let a coding agent build an app, use it, and diagnose failures without handing every step back to a person. Warm MCP tests show fresh-image OCR about 3.2 times faster than 1.4.1, iPhone context reads run in parallel, multiple agents can reserve a device without colliding, and Demo Studio can turn screen recordings into perspective device videos.
